+"""Load test for POST /webhooks/dhl: 10% exact duplicates, 5% same event with millisecond precision."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import random
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+
+from locust import FastHttpUser, constant_throughput, task
+
+STATUSES = ["PRE_TRANSIT", "IN_TRANSIT", "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY", "DELIVERED"]
+
+
+def _tracking() -> str:
+    return "JD0146" + "".join(random.choices("0123456789", k=14))
+
+
+def _event(tracking: str, status: str, when: datetime, *, millis: bool = False) -> dict:
+    ts = when.isoformat(timespec="milliseconds" if millis else "seconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
+    return {"shipments": [{"id": tracking, "status": {"statusCode": status, "timestamp": ts}}]}
+
+
+class DHLWebhook(FastHttpUser):
+    wait_time = constant_throughput(5)
+    recent: list[dict] = []
+
+    @task
+    def post_event(self) -> None:
+        roll = random.random()
+        if roll < 0.10 and self.recent:
+            body = random.choice(self.recent)
+        elif roll < 0.15 and self.recent:
+            base = random.choice(self.recent)["shipments"][0]
+            when = datetime.fromisoformat(base["status"]["timestamp"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+            body = _event(base["id"], base["status"]["statusCode"], when, millis=True)
+        else:
+            when = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(seconds=random.randint(0, 600))
+            body = _event(_tracking(), random.choice(STATUSES), when)
+            self.recent = (self.recent + [body])[-500:]
+        self.client.post("/webhooks/dhl", json=body, name="/webhooks/dhl")
